scope: Source/JSON only. Four-before-array loading order is established by reviewed worker source and successful terminal receipts, not independent syscall instrumentation. Inclusive phase times are not summed.

retained_prefix_diagnostics.wall_accounting: diagnostic bookkeeping included in existing wall budget

observed_greedy.call_cap_scope: no branching transition budget in this method; native-preview and wall guards apply

existing_accounting.within_call_costs: nominal clone, certificate checks, all candidate scoring, selected commits and needed inventories
